projects.title: Darknet Accelerator
projects.description: Zynq MPSoC-based system design accelerating the Darknet neural-network framework.
features: Converted Darknet from FP32 to INT16 and implemented multi-threading.
Developed a QEMU-SystemC TLM-based virtual platform prototype of a CPU + accelerator system.
Developed Linux kernel modules and hardware abstraction layers for HW/SW integration.
Accelerated Darknet using a custom GEMM accelerator and Xilinx DPU, deploying yolov3-tiny on the Ultra96 FPGA.

projects.title: Compute Near Memory Test Chip
projects.description: TSMC 65nm MPW tapeout (RTL-to-GDS + post-silicon testing) of a compute-near-memory architecture.
features: Contributed to the end-to-end design cycle of a compute-near-memory test chip in TSMC 65nm — architecture exploration, RTL design, verification, and physical implementation for convolution, arithmetic, and logic operations.
Performed post-silicon bring-up and developed PCB and FPGA-based emulation and test infrastructure.

projects.title: Agentic RTL Debug Fabric
projects.description: An MCP server with design and waveform introspection tools that lets a generalist coding agent root-cause failing SystemVerilog simulations.
features: Built an MCP server exposing design and waveform introspection tools to a generalist coding agent for root-causing failing SystemVerilog simulations.
Implemented EDA-tool-agnostic design-scope navigation and waveform inspection.
Developed driver/load causality tracing, value-aware X root-cause analysis, and combinational-loop detection.
Created a signal-force/recompute layer for hypothesis testing by correlating elaborated RTL with waveform samples.

projects.title: LogicNets+
projects.description: A framework for low-latency binary neural network inference on FPGAs, extending Xilinx Research's LogicNets.
features: Extended the LogicNets framework — originally for GEMM / fully-connected layers — to support Conv2D, DepthwiseConv2D, and PointwiseConv2D via truth-table-based neuron implementations.
Achieved ~90% accuracy and <20 ns inference latency at 200 MHz on representative networks.

projects.title: Hardware Accelerator Extension Interface for RISC-V CPUs
projects.description: Co-processor-agnostic accelerator adapter for RISC-V CPUs, based on OpenHW Group's Core-V Extension Interface.
features: Researched open-source co-processor interfaces and designed a co-processor-agnostic accelerator adapter for a RISC-V core.
Based on OpenHW Group's Core-V Extension Interface Specifications, enabling seamless integration of custom accelerators with RISC-V cores.

projects.title: RPHAX
projects.description: Rapid prototyping of hardware accelerators on Xilinx FPGAs — Google Summer of Code 2022.
features: Designed automation frameworks for IP packaging (AXI4-Lite, AXI Stream), block design, and bitstream generation.
Enabled a single-command, end-to-end Zynq-based flow to prototype standalone IPs.

projects.title: Transaction-Level RISC-V RV32IC CPU Core
projects.description: Multi-stage RISC-V RV32IC CPU core generator with physical implementation on the 130nm SkyWater PDK.
features: Designed a configurable 1–6-stage pipelined RISC-V CPU core generator using Transaction-Level Verilog, validated with assembly programs.
Completed RTL-to-GDSII with open-source tools and the 130nm SkyWater PDK, meeting timing and producing a DRC- and LVS-clean GDSII.

projects.title: Design Verification Projects
projects.description: A collection of formal and UVM-based verification projects.
features: Formal verification of AXI-Stream and AXI-Stream-to-AXI-Lite bridges using Cadence JasperGold, including comparison of formal engines.
Logic equivalence checking for the writeback stage of the ARM Amber core using Cadence Conformal.
Sequential equivalence checking of a pipelined multiplier using Synopsys VC Formal and Verdi.
Assertion-based verification of an Ethernet MAC module and Wishbone interface.
UVM-based verification of a 32-bit ALU from the ARM Amber core.
